title: Corporate Reduction Taken off the Closing Rate of a Hotel Night
content:
A corporate reduction is taken off the closing rate where a reservation in the Hotel Rate Plans range is made under a corporate travel programme. It is read from the negotiated hotel discount of the active programme in the Corporate Travel Programmes range the reservation is made under and from the hotel booking fees billed to that programme in the last twelve months.

Where the reservation is made under an active corporate programme whose negotiated hotel discount is at or above 8 percent, the corporate reduction is that programme's own negotiated hotel discount.

Where the reservation is made under an active corporate programme whose negotiated hotel discount is below 8 percent, and the hotel booking fees billed to that programme in the last twelve months come to 18.00 USD or more, the corporate reduction is 3 percent.

In every other case the corporate reduction is nil.

**No club discount alongside.** No club discount is applied to the closing night charge on top of the corporate reduction, the two never standing together on one reservation.

**What is counted.** Only lines billed as a hotel booking fee are counted in that twelve-month figure, and lines posted more than twelve months before the closing night is priced are not counted.

| The active corporate programme | Hotel booking fees billed to it in the last twelve months | Corporate reduction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Negotiated hotel discount at or above 8 percent | Any amount | That programme's own negotiated hotel discount |
| Negotiated hotel discount below 8 percent | 18.00 USD or more | 3 percent |
| Negotiated hotel discount below 8 percent | Less than 18.00 USD | Nil |
| No active programme | — | Nil |

*Both sides of the thresholds, on hypothetical figures.* A programme whose negotiated hotel discount is 8 percent takes its own 8 percent. One whose discount is 7.5 percent, with 18.00 USD of hotel booking fees billed in the last twelve months, takes 3 percent; with 17.99 USD billed it takes nil. A programme whose discount is 11 percent takes 11 percent whatever the fees billed to it. A reservation made under no active programme takes nil.
